llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床随机对照试验，研究褪黑素对全髋关节置换术后睡眠的改善作用，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical trial on postoperative sleep quality and does not include any biomechanical analysis, finite element modeling, stress shielding, micromotion, or implant design related to hip implants.

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the efficacy of melatonin in improving sleep quality following primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial was conducted.
summary_en.result: Melatonin showed potential benefits for postoperative sleep, but further studies are needed.
summary_en.validation: Clinical trial with randomized double-blind design.

papers.title: Risk Factors in Patients Who Had Prior Renal or Liver Transplant Undergoing Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.abstract: ASA 4 and bisphosphonates were associated with a higher risk of acute medical complications, whereas older age was associated with lower surgical complications. Additionally, older age, ASA 4, and AFib were associated with higher mortality.
